crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin slips under $67,000 overnight
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC fell below $67,000 Friday night ET, with ETH under $1,900, XRP under $1.00 and SOL under $75, and over $330 million liquidated in two hours.

crypto_headlines.title: Seventh straight day of Bitcoin ETF outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $185 million in net outflows on Nov 13, their seventh trading day in a row, while spot Ethereum ETFs took in $2.36 million.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose about $1.07 billion on the week
crypto_headlines.summary: Farside's weekly tally shows $1,065.3 million in net outflows, led by IBIT at -$908.4 million and FBTC at -$111.3 million.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase Institutional: the Fed, not the Binance hack, drove the drop
crypto_headlines.summary: Coinbase Institutional's weekly report says Bitcoin's recent decline came mainly from shifting Fed rate expectations rather than the Binance hack.

crypto_headlines.title: 2010-era Bitcoin wallets wake up
crypto_headlines.summary: Two wallets dormant since 2010 moved a combined 100 BTC, worth about $6.9 million, after more than 16 years of inactivity.

doginal_news.title: Five live shows on a red Friday
doginal_news.summary: The community lined up five CryptoSpacesNet shows with the Doginal Dogs on Friday, including Awakening Alpha with Vee, the Finance Show with Shibo and Bark, an NFT roundtable and Simply Crypto with Leah.

doginal_news.title: Floor holds at 45k DOGE
doginal_news.summary: Friday night the floor was still 45k DOGE (about $2.91k) with the same 17 asks all day and no sale since #495 on Nov 3, even with BTC down near $68.4k.

doginal_news.title: Championship registration closes Monday
doginal_news.summary: Sign-ups for the first official DDLTCG Championship close Monday, Nov 16 at 12 AM ET; every player gets an exclusive Giga Rare Victorious Gary promo, and the top 16 advance to the Miami finals.

doginal_news.title: Card spotlight: Bender, Legendary Zombie
doginal_news.summary: For Friday the 13th: Bender is a 5-mana 5/3 that brings back up to two Creatures costing 2 or less from your graveyard when played.

doginal_news.title: More markets land on Pyth Pro
doginal_news.summary: Pyth Pro added extended-hours US equity coverage, coffee, gasoil and lithium futures, and new agricultural Pyth Indices.

doginal_news.title: Douro Labs tells the CFTC to use multi-source prices
doginal_news.summary: Pyth core contributor Douro Labs commented on the CFTC's Crypto Asset Market framework, recommending multi-source price aggregates over a single venue's feed for margining and liquidations.

notes: No new original posts from the official Doginal Dogs account in the last day; Doginal Dogs items come from community posts. Nothing new on Toot, Atlas or Boogie.
